name: How can I prevent black mold from returning after removal?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent black mold from returning after removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing black mold recurrence focuses on moisture control. Promptly fix any leaks in plumbing, roofs, or foundations. Ensure proper ventilation in bathrooms, kitchens, and laundry areas, using exhaust fans. Keep indoor humidity levels below 60% using dehumidifiers if necessary, especially in damp basements. Clean and dry areas after flooding or water intrusion within 24-48 hours. Regularly clean gutters and ensure proper drainage away from your foundation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold recurrence by controlling moisture: fix leaks promptly, ensure good ventilation, maintain low indoor humidity, and dry wet areas quickly after any water event.
